thread:
ana (partnerships): Quick escalation — APAC partner portal blocked our marketplace listing. PO rejected due to billing entity / signer locale mismatch. Holding publish. Error code: BILLING_ENTITY_MISMATCH. PO attached below.

sam (revops): Can you paste the PO JSON? Is this for Acme APAC or the global Acme entity?

ana (partnerships): PO snippet:
```json
{
  "po_number": "PO-2026-4567",
  "billing_entity": "Acme APAC Pty Ltd",
  "signer": "John Doe",
  "tax_id": "AU123456789",
  "currency": "AUD"
}
```

marta (finance): We haven't onboarded Acme APAC as a separate bill-to. Need vendor onboarding + APAC tax docs (GST). Can we map to parent Acme, Inc. for our marketplace billing?

leo (legal): Also flagging PO term mismatches — partner portal auto-accepts net30 but our marketplace template is net45. Not fatal to publish but affects billing ops. Copying contract team.

sam (revops): Options: 1) ask partner to update billing entity to "Acme, Inc." (fast if they agree) 2) RevOps add vendor alias mapping in portal (takes ~2h) 3) Temp: mark listing as private-preview so we can publish and not block launch. Which do you prefer?

ana (partnerships): Partner prefers NOT to change entity; asking for vendor alias mapping. Can RevOps create alias now?

vendor-portal-bot: Vendor alias request submitted (req-8842). Current ETA: ~3 hours.

marta (finance): I'll open vendor onboarding ticket and request APAC tax docs. @leo please confirm whether we can accept alias + later commercial reconciliation.

leo (legal): Fine to accept alias as a stop-gap, but require written note in the ticket and counter-signed PO capturing which legal entity is ultimately liable. Also do NOT accept partner edits to indemnity clause; keep standard language.

sam (revops): Creating RevOps task now and assigning owner. @marta assigning vendor-alias work to me so I can push portal change.

ana (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If alias isn't live by 16:00 UTC we'll flip the listing to private-preview and proceed with the launch plan. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

(Attached: original PO PDF, portal rejection screenshot)
